title: The Iron Typewriter
author: Sable Marchetti
blurb: Coral Reyes, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
